t: You are looking at St Mary Magdalene, Paddington, a Grade I listed Anglican church on Rowington Close, dedicated to Saint Mary Magdalene, a follower of Jesus. The architect was George Edmund Street, born at Woodford in Essex and a leading practitioner of the Victorian Gothic Revival. Though he worked mainly on churches, he is perhaps best known for designing the Royal Courts of Justice on the Strand. This church is one of his ecclesiastical works, and its Grade I listing puts it among the most highly protected buildings in the country.
